flow cytometry.readouts: frequencies/proportions of CD4+CD8+ double-positive T cells, CD4+ single-positive T cells, and CD8+ single-positive T cells

evidence_location.quote: As shown in Figure 1 C, we observed a significant higher proportion ( p < 0.0001) of CD4 + CD8 + DP T cells in the D+L group (median 1.45%, interquartile range (IQR): 1.13–2.07%) compared to the D-L group (median 0.77%, IQR: 0.31–1.10%), with no differences detected for CD4 + or CD8 + SP T cells

RNA-seq.sample_type: sorted CD4+CD8+ double-positive T cells, CD4+ single-positive T cells, and CD8+ single-positive T cells from PBMCs
RNA-seq.readouts: gene expression profiles, clustering relationships, differentially expressed genes

evidence_location.quote: Cell subsets were sorted and RNA-seq performed, followed by clustering analyses using UMAP for dimensionality reduction. As shown in Figure 2 A, at the transcriptomic level, CD4 + CD8 + DP T cells were well resolved from CD4 + SP T cells but co-clustered with CD8 + SP T cells.
